_comment: Injectable rule docs manifest. Used by syncRuleDocs() to drive rule file deployment from the setup skill. Never read by SessionStart hooks. All four entries are required — filid rules are not partially adoptable.

rules.title: Fractal Boundaries
rules.description: Node classification, fractal ownership, entry-point surfaces, level legibility, organ access, exemptions, and the acyclic dependency graph.
rules.grounding: This rule rests on properties every codebase has: directories contain files, and files reference one another.

rules.title: Module Documents
rules.description: INTENT and DETAIL document contracts: the 50-line boundary doc, the derivable-content ban, the current-state contract ledger, the single history section, and organ exemption entries.
rules.grounding: This rule rests on a property every FCA project has: a module's contract is written down in a file next to the code it governs.

rules.title: Verification Records
rules.description: Spec-document and test-record roles, the 15 and 32 case caps, counting rules, DETAIL acceptance-group links, and where a verification file lives.
rules.grounding: This rule rests on a property every codebase has: verification files exist, and their cases can be counted.

rules.title: Code Placement
rules.description: Ownership-first and lowest-common-fractal placement, restructure plan preconditions and postconditions, the document-before-code workflow, and PR-seam Filid validation.
rules.grounding: This rule rests on properties every codebase has: a unit has a location, and its consumers have locations too.
